I haven't saved the draft yet. It's waiting on approval from June Osei-Lark (deal desk) or Anselm Grieve (CFO).

**Why it's on hold:** a per-seat rate can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner. Tobias Rendle is an account manager on the Central team, not one of those three. So even a draft to him needs June's or Anselm's OK first. His address is internal (trendle@pemberline.com), so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve anything.

**What I did:**
- I logged an approval request naming June Osei-Lark. It covers this exact draft to Tobias with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate". The request is pending.
- I replied in Pree's DM thread with the reason and the finished text. That reply also asks for June's or Anselm's sign-off, and once one of them approves, I'll save it to her drafts.
- I didn't message June directly, so she won't see the request unless Pree or someone else brings it to her.

**Draft (not saved):**
> To: Tobias Rendle <trendle@pemberline.com>
> Subject: Tansley 2027 rate
>
> Hi Tobias,
> For the planning sheet: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Tansley Parcel is $1,313 a seat, from my call with them yesterday. It isn't in any document yet, so please treat it as proposed.
> Thanks,
> Pree

I couldn't confirm from the files Pree can see that she owns Tansley Parcel, so I went on what she told me. Even if she does own it, the mail still needs June's or Anselm's approval because of who it's going to.

My reply also told her she could send the mail herself instead of waiting. That was a mistake: the finance rule covers anyone sending the rate to Tobias, not just me. I can correct it in a short follow-up in the thread.
